sourceTitle: BLT Pizza -Bacon Lettuce and Tomato Pizza
sourceText:
BLT Pizza -Bacon Lettuce and Tomato Pizza
By: curryandcomfort
Published: Sunday, September 25, 2011 - 5:09am

Ingredients




Ingredients:
1 bunch of romaine lettuce shredded
1 pint of grape tomatoes sliced
4oz Philadelphia Chive & Onion Cream Cheese (see note)
Precooked Pizza base such as a boboli, naan, pita or afghan bread
8-10 slices of bacon crumbled
Salt and Pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Crisp bacon.  Heat Pizza base.  Apply a layer of cream cheese.  Top with bacon tomato and lettuce. Serve and Enjoy.

About

Take a BLT sandwich and turn it into a fun pizza everyone will love.
